entities.name: Arabidopsis MBP2C
observations: Exact sequence match to UniProt Q9LEZ4, a reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana microtubule binding protein 2C.
Length is 326 aa; predicted molecular mass 37.35 kDa and theoretical pI 4.97.
Pfam MBP2C domain PF30916.1 spans residues 6–325.
Curated function includes RNA binding, microtubule/cytoskeleton regulation, interference with homeodomain protein association to plasmodesmata, and restriction of tobamovirus movement.
Curated localization is cytoplasm and microtubule cytoskeleton, with cytosolic puncta when associated with STM.
Reported processes include plasmodesmata-mediated intercellular transport, cortical cytoskeleton organization, stomatal patterning, drought response, and antiviral defense.
Reported interaction partner is the homeobox protein STM.

entities.name: Arabidopsis STM
observations: Homeodomain protein reported to interact with MBP2C; MBP2C prevents its association with plasmodesmata and alters its RNA-binding capacity.

entities.name: Cytoskeleton organization
observations: MBP2C is annotated to regulate cytoskeleton organization and cortical microtubule organization.

entities.name: Plasmodesmata transport
observations: MBP2C negatively regulates plasmodesmata-mediated intercellular protein transport by affecting homeodomain protein association with plasmodesmata.

entities.name: Plant antiviral defense
observations: MBP2C is annotated to contribute to host defense against tobamoviruses, likely by interfering with viral cell-to-cell movement.
